# Command: /clean

Remove old test results, video recordings, and reports to free up disk space.

## Instructions:
1. Execute terminal command:
   ```bash
   npm run clean
   ```
2. Inform tester: `test-results/`, `playwright-report/`, and `blob-report/` have been successfully cleaned.
